006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
018
019import java.util.List;
020import java.util.stream.Collectors;
021import java.util.stream.Stream;
022
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
024import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
025
026/**
027 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
028 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-string-join">fn:string-join</a>
029 * function.
030 */
031public final class FnStringJoin {
032  private static final String NAME = "string-join";
033  @NonNull
034  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_ONE_ARG = IFunction.builder()
035      .name(NAME)
036      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
037      .deterministic()
038      .contextIndependent()
039      .focusIndependent()
040      .argument(IArgument.builder()
041          .name("arg1")
042          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
043          .oneOrMore()
044          .build())
045      .returnType(IStringItem.type())
046      .returnOne()
047      .functionHandler(FnStringJoin::execute)
048      .build();
049
050  @NonNull
051  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_TWO_ARG = IFunction.builder()
052      .name(NAME)
053      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
054      .deterministic()
055      .contextIndependent()
056      .focusIndependent()
057      .argument(IArgument.builder()
058          .name("arg1")
059          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
060          .zeroOrMore()
061          .build())
062      .argument(IArgument.builder()
063          .name("arg2")
064          .type(IStringItem.type())
065          .zeroOrOne()
066          .build())
067      .returnType(IStringItem.type())
068      .returnOne()
069      .functionHandler(FnStringJoin::execute)
070      .build();
071
072  private FnStringJoin() {
073    // disable construction
074  }
075
076  @SuppressWarnings({ "unused", "PMD.OnlyOneReturn" })
077  @NonNull
078  private static ISequence<IStringItem> execute(
079      @NonNull IFunction function,
080      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
081      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
082      IItem focus) {
083
084    ISequence<IAnyAtomicItem> arg1 = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
085    IStringItem arg2 = arguments.size() == 1 ? IStringItem.valueOf("")
086        : FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true));
087
088    if (arg1.isEmpty()) {
089      return ISequence.of(IStringItem.valueOf(""));
090    }
091
092    return ISequence.of(fnStringJoin(ObjectUtils.notNull(arg1), arg2));
093  }
094
095  /**
096   * An implementation of XPath 3.1 <a href=
097   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-string-join">fn:string-join</a>.
098   *
099   * @param items
100   *          the items to join in string form
101   * @param separator
102   *          the optional separator to use between joined items
103   * @return the atomized result
104   */
105  @NonNull
106  public static IStringItem fnStringJoin(
107      @NonNull List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> items,
108      @Nullable IStringItem separator) {
109    return IStringItem.valueOf(stringJoin(
110        ObjectUtils.notNull(items.stream().map(item -> item == null ? "" : IStringItem.cast(item).asString())),
111        separator == null ? "" : separator.asString()));
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * An implementation of XPath 3.1 <a href=
116   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-string-join">fn:string-join</a>.
117   *
118   * @param items
119   *          the items to join in string form
120   * @param separator
121   *          the optional separator to use between joined items
122   * @return the atomized result
123   */
124  @NonNull
125  private static String stringJoin(
126      @NonNull Stream<String> items,
127      @NonNull String separator) {
128    return ObjectUtils.notNull(items.collect(Collectors.joining(separator)));
129  }
130}
